script_text:
Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your Earth-sign ruling planet, is squaring Saturn in your 10th House of career and reputation, while activating your 4th House of emotional roots with a tense opposition to the Moon. This creates friction between safety-seeking and ambitious expansion, so delay bold moves.

In love, if partnered, your 7th House of intimacy may face cold silences or power struggles; if single, your 6th House of service attracts someone loyal through steady effort, and your Venus needs gentle words, for avoidance will only deepen the ache. Avoid assuming jealousy is love.

Financially, the 2nd House of money feels the square, so pause risky investments and protect your resources. Public confidence may waver, but unexpected blessing arrives through a trusted elder's practical help. Tonight, breathe before deciding.

Always follow for tomorrow's reading.
